protocol.time_step: Decision D13 (2026-10-05): the lagged normal-increment capillary term is on (Surface_tension_semi_implicit = NormalIncrement) and every level uses one fixed physical step: dt = 0.02 at La = 12 and dt = 0.01 at La = 120 (618 and 3900 steps at any R/h). The output cadence is the nearest whole number of steps per 1/100 of the run, which ends at the first output at or after 5 viscous times. Other Laplace numbers keep the earlier capillary-limit rule (time_step_before_D13). Each study is run at dt and at dt/2 (generate_case.py --dt-divisor 1 and 2); see time_step_criterion.
protocol.time_step_before_D13: Until 2026-10-05, with the term off: dt <= m * dt_B, dt_B = sqrt(rho*h^3/(4*pi*gamma)) = (1/sqrt(2)) * sqrt(rho*h^3/(2*pi*gamma)), rounded down so that the run is 100 equal output intervals; m = 2 at La = 12 and m = 1 at La = 120. Changed on 2026-09-30 from m = 1 at every La: the step-0 measurement (tracker, jobs 46075447 and 46076505) found that the outer geometry loop accepts 2 dt_B at La = 12 and only dt_B at La = 120 with its default 12-pass cap. The gated metrics are relaxed steady-state values, so the time step does not enter them (decision D10; README.md). Reproduced by generate_case.py --dt-multiple <m> --surface-tension-semi-implicit None.
protocol.level_set_velocity: Level-set advection velocity (decision D9): see README.md for the value in use and its validation.
protocol.note: Criteria apply separately to each (capillary form, Laplace number, dt divisor) refinement study, and must pass at dt and at dt/2. See README.md for the definitions and the cost of each level.

criteria.definition: |(p_in - p_ext) - gamma/R_eff| / (gamma/R_eff) at the end of the run. p_in is the area-weighted mean of the P1 pressure over the triangles lying entirely inside the disc of radius R_eff/2 about the liquid centroid; R_eff = sqrt(A/pi), A the exact area of {phi_h < 0}.
criteria.order_method: least-squares slope of log(error) against log(R/h) over order_levels; pairwise orders are reported
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5, M2: pressure-jump error <= 1% at R/h = 32 with observed order >= 1)

criteria.definition: Ca_sp = mu * max|u_h| / gamma, max over the vertices with phi_h < 0 (July spatial definition), taking the largest value over the outputs in the final quarter of the run (t > 3T/4).
criteria.source: Decision of 2026-09-29 recorded in the tracker (section 5, M2): no absolute limit. The spurious flow must decrease strictly under refinement, and no_velocity_growth must hold; absolute values are reported. The earlier July-based limit was dropped because the July 'speed per surface tension' was a start-up transient in SI units, not a capillary number (see reference_july_2026 and README.md).

reference_july_2026.definition: speed per surface tension = max over the vertices with initial phi < 0 of |u_h| in the last output, divided by gamma, in SI units (1/(Pa s))
reference_july_2026.setup: SurfaceStress, R = 0.3 m circle centred in the unit box, Quad4 n x n cells (R/h = 2.4, 4.8, 9.6), high-order implicit cuts, rho = 998.2 kg/m^3, mu = 1.003e-3 Pa s, gamma = 0.5 N/m, La = 2.98e8, pressure preloaded to gamma/R, 3 steps of dt = 1e-3 s (t = 3e-3 s = 3.4e-8 viscous times)

criteria.definition: max|u_h| (liquid vertices) at the end of the run divided by the largest max|u_h| over the outputs in the third quarter of the run (T/2 <= t <= 3T/4). A ratio <= 1 means the final value lies within the envelope of the preceding quarter.
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5, M2: no growth of max|u| in time)

criteria.definition: max over all outputs of |A(t) - A(0)| / A(0), with A the exact area of {phi_h < 0} and A(0) that of the sampled initial level set in mesh/mesh-complete.mesh.vtu
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5, M2: volume drift <= 1e-4)

time_step_criterion.source: Decision D13 (design note Documentation/free_surface_semi_implicit_surface_tension_design.md, section 9.9): every gate passes at both steps, and the gated pressure jump changes by at most 0.1% when the step is halved. Measured in section 9.3: at most 5.9e-6 (La = 12) and 5.2e-6 (La = 120).
time_step_criterion.definition: |dp(dt) - dp(dt/2)| / |dp(dt/2)|, dp = p_in - p_ext as in pressure_jump, between the dt divisor 1 and 2 studies of one (capillary form, Laplace number) at their finest common level.
time_step_criterion.at_level: finest common level of the dt and dt/2 studies
time_step_criterion.gates_at_each_step: every criterion applies to the dt and to the dt/2 study; refined_step_levels = all means the dt/2 study must contain every level the criteria need
time_step_criterion.reported_note: Ca_sp is reported for each step and level (it depends on dt at coarse levels; design note section 9.8, risk 4).
time_step_criterion.when_one_divisor_only: reported as not evaluated; does not fail
